newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby league-Injured Clyde misses test selection.
newsitem.headline: Rugby league-Injured Clyde misses test selection.

text.p: Australia selectors overlooked injured Canberra lock Brad Clyde on Tuesday when they announced the side to play New Zealand in the inaugural Super League test on Anzac Day.
Clyde missed last Friday's tri-series match between New South Wales and Queensland and also Canberra's win over Penrith due to ankle injury.
Brisbane's Darren Smith was named in Clyde's place, while Penrith teenager Craig Gower was chosen as hooker ahead of veteran rake Steve Walters.
Australia will be captained by Laurie Daley.
New Zealand on Monday announced a strong side to be captained by Steve Kearney.

Australia - David Peachey; Ken Nagas, Andrew Ettingshausen, Ryan Girdler, Wendell Sailor; Laurie Daley (captain), Allan Langer; Glenn Lazarus, Craig Gower, Rodney Howe, David Furner, Brad Thorn, Darren Smith. Reserves: Paul Green, Julian O'Neil, Matt Adamson, Solomon Haumono.

New Zealand - Henry Paul; Sean Hoppe, Ruben Wiki, John Timu, Richard Barnett; Gene Ngamu, Stacey Jones; Grant Young, Syd Eru, Quentin Pongia, Steve Kearney (captain), Tony Iro, Tawera Nikau. Reserves: Joe Vagana, Tyran Smith, Robbie Paul, Tea Ropati.
